title: Hybrid Adaptive Kalman Filtering for Data-Efficient Joint Tracking and Classification
abstract: arXiv:2606.02767v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Kalman filtering performance is highly sensitive to model mismatch and noise covariance tuning. Classical adaptive filtering methods address these issues by estimating model parameters or noise covariances from measurement data but rely on a predefined model structure. Learning-based methods provide greater flexibility but typically require large supervised datasets and often lack well-calibrated uncertainty estimates. This article proposes a self-supervised Hybrid Adaptive Kalman Filter (HAKF) that learns time-varying corrections to the system dynamics and process-noise covariance directly from measurements while jointly estimating the measurement-noise covariance. Because these corrections are learned from measurements alone, we analyze the structural identifiability of the corresponding time-invariant parameterizations. translated_abstract: 卡尔曼滤波的性能对模型失配和噪声协方差整定高度敏感。经典自适应滤波方法通过从量测数据中估计模型参数或噪声协方差来解决这些问题，但依赖于预先定义的模型结构。基于学习的方法提供了更大的灵活性，但通常需要大规模有监督数据集，且往往缺乏良好校准的不确定性估计。本文提出了一种自监督的混合自适应卡尔曼滤波器（HAKF），它直接从量测数据中学习对系统动力学和过程噪声协方差的时变修正，同时联合估计量测噪声协方差。由于这些修正仅从量测数据中学习获得，我们分析了相应时不变参数化的结构可辨识性。对于仅有位置量测的常速（CV）模型，无约束的过程噪声协方差是……
tldr: 本文提出一种自监督的混合自适应卡尔曼滤波器（HAKF），可直接从量测数据中学习系统动力学和过程噪声协方差的时变修正并联合估计量测噪声协方差，无需大规模有监督数据集即可实现数据高效的联合跟踪与分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-supervised Hybrid Adaptive Kalman Filter (HAKF) that learns time-varying corrections to system dynamics and process-noise covariance directly from measurements while jointly estimating measurement-noise covariance, enabling data-efficient joint tracking and classification without large supervised datasets.
